definitions: To be tricked or deceived into losing something, typically money or possessions.
To have something taken from you through dishonest means or a scam.
examples: She got conned out of her life savings.
He got conned out of his inheritance by a fake charity.
Don't get conned out of your money by online fraudsters.
pastTenses: got conned out of (past simple), got conned out of (present perfect)
